rows.label: tlk44310186_02_msg0001
rows.name:
We were ordered to let people enter
without permits, but I'm still not
used to it.

rows.label: tlk44310186_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I can't help but be suspicious
of all these unfamiliar faces.

rows.label: tlk44310186_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I wonder how other countries maintain
public order... I have a lot to learn.
